body.objective: Complete the validated projective Evans contour from the certified exact boundary prefix 123/512, count its enclosed axial spin-two zeros by a fail-closed argument-principle rail, and evaluate the intrinsic tangent selector only after a root count is certified.
body.stop_condition: Import commit 39cabf422 and its v7, v7b and v8 certificates by exact hashes. Continue from the honest next gap 246/1024 in bounded chunks, preserving the common projective mismatch section, moving endpoint phases and stable-root convention. Either certify nonvanishing on the complete closed contour and an exact winding/root count, or stop at the first irreparable panel with a typed enclosure obstruction. If exactly one simple QNM is certified, localize it and test the projective intrinsic tangent delta_tau without inferring nonvanishing from rational nonsplitting. Record separately the connection-level Smith conclusion and the still-conditional Fredholm/Green-resolvent promotion.
body.current_gate: Validated continuation from 123/512 to a complete zero-free contour; argument principle and Smith selector remain unopened until that boundary gate passes
body.forbid: no certified prefix called a closed contour; no sampled winding called an argument-principle count; no QNM inferred before the full boundary excludes zero; no nonzero differential extension called a nonzero QNM selector; no connection Smith branch promoted to a Green-resolvent pole without the analytic Fredholm realization; no mode-stability, time-domain, ringdown, particle or quantum claim
activates: a certified local axial QNM Smith test if and only if the contour count isolates a simple spin-two zero
the conditional repeated-block Fredholm principal-part theorem after its graph-norm realization is separately established
body.resource_hint: Use projective Riccati/Grassmann transport with correlated parameter arithmetic. Keep producer chunks below the approximately 60-second scoped-loop target; the 32-panel v8 run is an affected-chain receipt, not the future fast-loop template.
notes: The complete-contour, argument-principle, QNM, Smith, beta_n and EP2 flags are false at activation.
